definitions.gloss: to take in, to bring in
definitions.explanation: To bring something inside; to take in laundry, etc.
To adopt or incorporate something (ideas, data, technology, etc.).
To import or capture digital data or images into a device.

notes:
{取|と}り{込|こ}む is a compound verb meaning to take in, incorporate, or import.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into) → to take into.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ particle

FUNCTIONS:
1. Physical: bringing things inside
   - ⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{込|こ}む: bring in laundry
   - ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{込|こ}む: bring in futon

2. Abstract: incorporating ideas/elements
   - ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{込|こ}む: incorporate opinions
   - ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{込|こ}む: adopt technology

3. Digital: importing data
   - ⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{込|こ}む: import images
   - ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{込|こ}む: import data

SET PHRASE — {取|と}り{込|こ}み⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧:
{取|と}り{込|こ}み⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ means "tied up at the moment, in the middle of something," and is a standard polite way to decline an interruption — ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧{取|と}り{込|こ}み⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦な→だ：09496_da⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧ (since I'm tied up right now). It comes from an older sense of the verb, "to be thrown into confusion," and is not predictable from the three senses above.
